# Copilot instructions

This repository contains the Field Read skill. When asked where a field is going, whether one field is a better place to be than another, or what a technology does to a kind of role, follow `skills/field-read/SKILL.md` and its `references/` files. Use the public record only, mark every claim as cited, inferred or unknown, never open LinkedIn profiles, record the base rate before any scenario, give every scenario a dated confirming signal and a killing signal, and keep comparisons symmetric.
